changes: Fixed Gemini up/down translation swap and applied left/right fix to the Earth system.
Use vehicle bounding sphere radius as the camera distance power base, when available.
flare is no longer active while in "map mode" - you can plan your orbits in relative peace!
the sun in a sunset looks like a sunset again
toned down a spoke distance default parameter to taste just slightly

Reworked the Select System on startup popup to include texture cap configuration. This allows users to specify texture caps for different category of textures as well as the shadow map before boot begins. This will help configure especially on low end systems. This can dramatically lower the GPU VRAM usage.
Added new setting to TextureManifests, and an example file.
Fixed a sign flip that was incorrectly increasing propellant usage.
Completed and incomplete comment about control input scaling.

Fixed an error where main engines would cut off at exactly the end of the integration timestep, leading to half of the expected thrust by blending between full thrust at the start and zero at the end.
Added start burn time calculation to split the maneuver burn halfway between before and after the maneuver time (temporary for now) - until we have stages, differing ISP, etc.
Added display of the burn time and the time to actually start the burn to the UI.
Changed the Button display to not show the Maneuver related row of buttons for a vehicle if the vehicle currently has no maneuvers.

Added new VRAM estimation system that will display live information of a rough VRAM estimate when player is changing settings during boot. System templates that are estimated to be too big, with selected settings, will display in red text but still allow loading. Requires those adding textures to systems to run the generate command (possibly run this automatically during pack/bake).
Fix issue where dedicated compute queue ignored Graphics capable queues
Fixed both Celestial and Vehicle debug axes drawing simultaneously.
Changed Celestials to draw CCF axes in RGB.
Corrected east-north-up frame rate calculations after testing in very eccentric and inclined orbits.
Fixed texture size estimation issue from mixing up bits and bytes. Now correctly displays the size in the UI.
Fixed issues with primary constructor propagation caused wrapping byte size calculation at high resolutions.
Add setting for swapping between Vulkan API v1.3 and v1.2
KSA uses 1.3 by default but still works with 1.2 so we want to check for compatability differences with older GPUS
Started work on connection locations for parts/subparts
Fixed importer for meshes authored by 3ds max
Cleanup of texture command to support more actions.
Added first pass of texture import supporting different texture import settings.
Extended seek next/previous system to support more than just vehicles. Added Action that allows cycling through all astronomical objects (default semicolon, apostrophe).
Added serialization and deserialization of ManeuverPlan data in save files. Pass one. Needs some cleanup and improvements in pass two.
Change default planet shadow resolution and bias settings to fix banding
Fix clouds shifting when reapplying graphics settings
Fixed Generate.comp not using the number of objects per cell edge when computing the cell position for a given object.
Replaced ground clutter compute shader Dispatch calls with DispatchIndirect to improve performance when performing many dispatches.
Fixed CommandBufferPool SubmitFinalize only submitting one wait stage flag instead of one per semaphore
Fixed boxing of Enum values by use of HasFlag to the small object heap, replaced with bitwise checks.

Added the basic structure for plugging a flight computer into the physics update step. For the moment, this simply passes through manual inputs. The next step will be to add an auto-burn feature for the maneuvers and an RCS attitude controller.
Tweaked thruster cutoff logic to try and avoid time precision issues.
Merged time warp control cutoff logic so rotation and translation lock out at the same speed.
Corrected Gemini wet and dry masses.
Fixed Gemini mass properties in the Earth-only system as well.

Fixed an issue with NewtonRaphson solver infinite looping when eccentricity approaches 1 and starting mean anomaly is small. This manifested in the orbit of Lovejoy comet. Have added clamp to the delta as well as cubic approximation for the initial guess.
